description: List the company's reusable email components newest first. Components are saved block groups that can be dropped into emails, plus the components pinned as company defaults for a slot (currently `footer`). Pass defaultsOnly to see only the pinned defaults.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

defaultsOnly.description: When true, return only components pinned as a company default for a slot.

type.description: Optional component type filter. `section` is an ordinary saved block group; `footer` is a footer component.

name: list_email_components

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_email_components` MCP tool.

components.description: List of email component records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
